description: This file defines the File class which manages session data by reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting session files in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class that handles session data storage and management via file system operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the File object with the session configuration from the registry.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from the corresponding session file.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to the session file.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the session file corresponding to the given session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired session files based on configuration settings.
